instruction: Export this image as a PNG file named 'orange_output.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to move 'Thanks World' text layer to the left using Move tool. Selected the layer, pressed 'M' for Move, set 'Move the active layer' mode, and dragged text slightly left. However, text was not moved far enough (evaluator requires within left 5% of image width).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP interface, select layers in layers panel, activate tools via keyboard shortcuts (M for Move), configure tool options, drag layers on canvas
metadata.failure_analysis: Model moved text only slightly left (~139px drag), insufficient to reach the left 5% threshold of the 2192px-wide image. The drag distance was too small to satisfy the evaluator.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a basic export task. Tests whether the model can use File > Export As to save an XCF file as PNG with a specific filename. This is a fundamental GIMP operation within the model's demonstrated ability to navigate menus and interact with dialogs.
metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the opened XCF image as 'orange_output.png' to the Desktop. No postconfig needed since the model itself must perform the export. Evaluator uses official get_vm_file to download the exported file and check_image_size to verify it exists and has the original dimensions (2192x1118), confirming a correct export.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the exported file from /home/user/Desktop/orange_output.png via get_vm_file; returns None if file doesn't exist, causing metric to return 0.
Metric check_image_size correctly receives the rules dict directly (width=2192, height=1118) and validates both dimensions match the original XCF source image.
No postconfig needed — the agent performs the export, so the file should exist on disk when the evaluator runs.

Minor concern: evaluator only checks image dimensions, not content similarity. A different image with matching 2192x1118 dimensions would incorrectly pass. Using check_file_exists_and_structure_sim with the original XCF as reference would be more robust, but for this simple export task the dimension check is a reasonable proxy.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using check_file_exists_and_structure_sim instead of check_image_size to also verify image content matches the original, providing stronger verification that the correct image was exported.
